Topic 1.4: Field Management Practices ● Vegetable pruning ● Pruning perennial crop ● Top dressing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Field Management Practices ● Vegetable pruning ● Pruning perennial crop ● Top dressing, part of Crop Production in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 AGRICULTURE.

Key inquiry question: How do field management practices influence crop production?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. describe management practices of selected vegetable and perennial crops to improve yields, b) carry out selected management practices in crop production, c) explain factors considered in topdressing a crop field, Learner is guided in purposive group, pair or individually to: ● use digital devices to search for information or take a field trip to study pruning of vegetables such as capsicum, tomatoes, among others and perennial crops such as bananas, pyrethrum, coffee and tea. A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Field Management Practices ● Vegetable pruning ● Pruning perennial crop ● Top dressing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

(PCIs):
